articles.summary: BETHESDA, Md., Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Eagle Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: EGBN), the Bethesda-based holding company for EagleBank, one of the largest community banks in the Washington, D.C. region, announced today that Ces Escamilla has joined EagleBank as 1 st Senior Vice President, Senior Director of Commercial Real Estate (CRE) Strategic Growth. In this newly created role, Escamilla will lead efforts to expand EagleBank's CRE lending capabilities by helping architect, launch and scale new lines of business and specialized financing solutions. He will also focus on identifying and advancing strategic growth opportunities that broaden the bank’s capabilities, enhance client solutions, and support the continued evolution of EagleBank’s commercial real estate platform.
